title: What's new in Document Reporting: Word add-in (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Managing themes and layouts in Business Central

features.name: Company information dataset
features.description: A new pre-populated dataset automatically available in all Word layouts containing company data like logo, name, and address fields that do not need to be manually encoded.
features.status_evidence_quote: So we decided we wanted to ship that always. So in the future when you need to create a report uh with a word

features.name: Table builder editing
features.description: The table builder, previously in preview, now supports editing tables directly within the wizard interface, allowing users to add columns and modify table definitions without recreating them.

features.name: Address design control
features.description: A reusable design block for formatting addresses with three layout options: sender-receiver-shipping in three columns, receiver only, or other configurations.

features.name: Field group design control
features.description: A design component for displaying key-value pairs as label and data items, supporting single or double-stacked column grids with flexible field counts.

features.name: Amounts design control
features.description: A design component for visualizing calculations with captions and values, used across Business Central reports.

features.name: Signature line design control
features.description: A design block providing two types of signature lines: one with name and caption (for approvers) and one with notes option, used in quality management module.

features.name: Notes design control
features.description: A design component that allows selection of bullet point count and adds a corresponding design element for notes content in layouts.

features.name: Hide-if logical control
features.description: A logical control that hides or shows content based on a boolean value; future versions will support boolean expressions based on dataset values.
caveats: Boolean expressions coming in future versions

features.name: Theme sample documents
features.description: Pre-built sample layouts (invoice, pick list, outstanding orders) demonstrating how theme changes (styles, fonts, colors) affect document appearance, used by communication and back office teams.
caveats: Sample documents are not actual layouts, designed for theming preview only

features.name: Header footer layout templates
features.description: Eight to ten pre-built header footer layouts available by default; users can create custom layouts using the Word add-in with access to company information dataset.
